query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN comparedAt IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as compared,
       SUM(CASE WHEN evaluation = 'virtue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as virtue,
       SUM(CASE WHEN evaluation = 'landmine' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as landmine,
       SUM(CASE WHEN evaluation = 'neutral' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as neutral
FROM friend_predictions;
